  <p>Hi, I’m Seok-Ju! I am currently a postdoc at Argonne National Laboratory.</p>

  <p>My research is driven by a desire to improve real-world ML systems. Primary areas of interest include:</p>

  <ul class="interest-list">
    <li>
      <span class="interest-label"><strong>Algorithm Design:</strong></span>
      <span class="interest-underbrace">

  <p>In my free time, I sing 🎤 R&B and do kettlebell 🐮🔔 swings. I am open to new collaborations and opportunities. Let's connect!</p>
